measurement_basis: post-generation runtime PNGs plus declared gameplay timing

jab.motion_archetype: small compression -> quick extension -> guard recovery
jab.root_foot_policy: pivot measured from final PNG bbox; grounded states target ground_y 104
jab.center_of_mass_curve: measured in foot_contact_report pivot_drift_px per frame
jab.impact_readability: impact frame must be held by runtime_animation_timing_map
jab.fx_policy: hit spark is spr_hit_spark; no character sheet baked FX
jab.palette_flash_policy: runtime palette flash is separate policy; no uncontrolled requantization
